description: Name points in a score: where the picture cuts, a moment the music should hit, a section’s start. Each marker is given at a beat or at a time in seconds, and comes back with both, and its frame: the way to learn which beat a moment of the picture falls on. When the tempo changes, a marker given in seconds keeps its time and one given in beats keeps its beat. Markers change no sound. Replaces the list. Returns the new score_id (edit that one next) and the markers.
